title: The Day of the Unsent Postcard
skyStory: Seventy-one percent lit and growing, the moon is still swimming in Pisces, doing lazy backstrokes and humming. Waxing gibbous moons are almost there and know it. Neptune, ruler of Pisces, has left a stack of blank postcards on every windowsill. Nobody knows where the stamps are. That is part of the charm, and also extremely Neptune.

reading: The Tiger is tired and too proud to say so. Pisces sees through that in a heartbeat. Today, rest counts as work. A walk counts. Staring at the woodstove counts. If anyone asks what you accomplished, say 'I recharged the fire' and leave it there, mysteriously.

Late afternoon, around 4:44, you will think of a sentence that would make someone's whole week. Write it down. Maybe send it, maybe keep it for later. The [[Four of Cups]] is offering a gift you have been too busy to notice, and today the gift is your own quiet. Take it with both paws.
joel.mission: Write a postcard to someone you admire, address it, and keep it in a book as a bookmark until you are ready.
joel.omen: A cat asleep in a window, completely unbothered by the world. That is the assignment.

reading: The Rat is curled in the nest today with one eye open, and the open eye is noticing everything: who needs a laugh, which plant needs water, what the cat is plotting. You will get three small chances to help someone level up before lunch.

Take one. Leave the other two. Pisces wants you to save some energy for yourself and stop running the whole tide single-handed. In the evening, write a postcard you will never send, addressed to the mountain you used to be, telling her how far you have come. Read it out loud once, dramatically, to an empty room.
nancy.mission: Water one plant, or one person, with a compliment so specific it makes them blink.
nancy.omen: A bird bathing in a puddle with total commitment. Joy does not need a reason or an audience.

together.text: No missions tonight. Each of you pick one cozy thing, a blanket, a book, a long shower with music, and do it without guilt. Send one emoji to report in. The moon is filling up slowly, and so are you, one quiet evening at a time.

game.intro: Cozy night, so the studio dimmed the lights and lost all its facts in the couch cushions. Answer wrong. Answer comfy.
game.question: What is a postcard actually for?
